355620.<attr><feel_happy_lv2><end_attr><voice_n:
Good morning! The new day has begun. I wonder what adventures await me today?
Sword practice is great, but kicking back in your room has its charms too. So, what's it gonna be?

355621.<attr><feel_think_lv1><end_attr><voice_n:
<attr><feel_think_lv1><end_attr><voice_nw IEV_HSG_HYZ001 0>
Hey, good morning. Did you sleep well last
night?

355626.<attr><feel_happy_lv1><end_attr><voice_n:
Hey there! Hehe. I'm glad to see you giving it your all.
But please don't push yourself too hard. Getting plenty of rest at home is important, too.

355627.<attr><feel_angry_lv1><end_attr><voice_n:
<attr><feel_angry_lv1><end_attr><voice_nw IEV_HSG_HYZ002 0>
If I let my guard down now, I'll just space
out. Let's give it our all!

355632.<attr><feel_think_lv1><end_attr><voice_n:
Great job today! What kind of adventures did you have? I'd love to hear all about them.
But I have to watch out--if I get too caught up in chatting, I'll stay up way too late. It's so much fun that I tend to lose track of
time.

355633.<attr><feel_sad_lv1><end_attr><voice_nw:
<attr><feel_sad_lv1><end_attr><voice_nw IEV_HSG_HYZ003 0>
Is it that late already? The day just flies
by.

355638.<attr><feel_happy_lv3><end_attr><voice_n:
Today's a special anniversary for you, isn't it? I'm so happy we get to celebrate this momentous day together...!
I truly hope that today will be a happy day for you... I wish that with all my heart.
Hehe. Here's to marking another year together --may we keep celebrating this anniversary for many more to come.

355639.<attr><feel_happy_lv3><end_attr><voice_n:
So today's your special day, huh? I'm curious what kind of special day it is, but I guess asking would be a bit rude.
So, I guess it's just a day when something good happened... right? Well, then, I'd better make the most of it.

355644.<attr><feel_happy_lv1><end_attr><voice_n:
Wow, so you call Tale Spinner's Home your place, huh... Back when I was Mishua and my memory was gone, I used to stay in the same
house as Melsandy.
I used to wake up early in the morning to fetch water from the stream and take care of the animals with Raska... I was living a
simple, happy life.
That world might have been made up, but the memories I shared with Raska and the others are real. I'll never, ever forget them.

355645.<attr><feel_sad_lv1><end_attr><voice_nw:
Hey, wait a minute--is your house completely underground? That's pretty bold of you!
But it's not so bad. When you're sleeping under the stars, the real headache is keeping the rain and wind off you.
In that regard, this house is perfect. Even if something attacks us, we can just barricade ourselves in the basement.

355650.<attr><feel_sad_lv1><end_attr><voice_nw:
So they have those "School Classroom Chairs," huh? I heard they're the same ones used at Asfeld Academy.
Actually, I've never been to school. Tutors would come to the castle to teach me, so I've always yearned for real school life.
You get to wear matching uniforms, take classes, and play with kids your own age, right? School is such a wonderful place.

355651.<attr><feel_happy_lv1><end_attr><voice_n:
Huh? What's this? Water's flowing through it. You can eat somen like this, huh?
Hey, this little doll looks just like Somya--I wonder if he's a fan of somen noodles?
Hey, I could bring him a small token next time. Might be a blast if we tackle it together.

355656.<attr><feel_happy_lv1><end_attr><voice_n:
So you have a Diviner Table! I love fortune- telling, and every day I have my maid, Pixis, read my fortune.
Pixis has a real knack for crystal ball readings. Her predictions are always spot-on. A while back, she peered into the crystal ball
and said this:
"In the future, the princess will find someone irreplaceable and very dear to her," they said... Right? That's spot on, isn't it?

355657.<attr><feel_think_lv3><end_attr><voice_n:
Oh. This bed. I've seen it before in the Water Realm.
I sleep rough a lot, so I'm used to sleeping on the ground. I have a hard time nodding off in a bed.
Hey, I slept like a log in this bed. Mind if I crash here again later?

355662.<attr><feel_think_lv3><end_attr><voice_n:
So you've got a Storm Realm Rock, huh? Thunder and heroes go hand in hand.
Hero was born with the power of lightning, and it seems that among humans, only Hero can use the "Zap" spell. It's kind of mysterious,
isn't it?
I asked Lushenda why, and she said, That's just what a hero is. I'm not sure if I buy that or not.

355663.<attr><feel_think_lv2><end_attr><voice_n:
Huh? Is this the one called "Traveler's Guardian"? I used to spot it every now and then on the side of the road while I was
traveling.
I'm not exactly a religious guy, but I just couldn't bring myself to walk right past it without doing something.
I just dropped whatever I had on hand, and if something was dirty, I gave it a quick wipe. So far, though, I haven't gotten anything in
return.

355668.<attr><feel_happy_lv3><end_attr><voice_n:
Today's my birthday! I'm so glad you're here to celebrate with me.
You see, this day is a special day for Hero. It's said to be the memorable day when a brave young man set out on a journey to save the
world.
Just like that person, I, too, will take up my sword... and continue to protect Astoltia from now on. I swear that to you, my dearest.

355669.<attr><feel_happy_lv2><end_attr><voice_n:
I don't know if you knew this, but today's my birthday. Oh, not that I'm asking you to throw a party or anything.
I remember hearing from the old man who raised me--before I went to the orphanage--that it was a hell of a storm that day and things were
pretty rough.
I couldn't help but think, Guess that's why I keep stumbling down this rocky road...

355674.<attr><feel_happy_lv3><end_attr><voice_n:
<attr><feel_happy_lv3><end_attr><voice_nw IEV_HSG_ANR009 0>
Thank you for inviting me. I'm so happy to be
here at your house!

355675.<attr><feel_happy_lv1><end_attr><voice_n:
<attr><feel_happy_lv1><end_attr><voice_nw IEV_HSG_HYZ009 0>
Hey. Did you call me? I was just thinking I
wanted to see you, too.

355680.<voice_nw IEV_HSG_ANR010 0>\n「わかったわ。私は い:
<voice_nw IEV_HSG_ANR010 0>
All right. I'll head back to the guild for
now. If you need me, just send a summons. I'll
be there in a flash!

355681.<voice_nw IEV_HSG_HYZ010 0>\n「それじゃあ またな。:
<voice_nw IEV_HSG_HYZ010 0>
All right, see you around. Give me a shout
anytime.

355686.<attr><feel_happy_lv1><end_attr><voice_n:
<attr><feel_happy_lv1><end_attr><voice_nw IEV_HSG_ANR011 0>
Welcome! Make yourself at home.

355687.<attr><feel_happy_lv1><end_attr><voice_n:
<attr><feel_happy_lv1><end_attr><voice_nw IEV_HSG_HYZ011 0>
Hey. Glad you came. Well, make yourself at
home.

355692.<voice_nw IEV_HSG_ANR013 0>\n「おはようっ！\n<b:
Good morning!
I usually keep a low profile inside the castle, but it feels so good to greet people out loud like this.

355693.<voice_nw IEV_HSG_HYZ013 0>\n「おう おはようさん。:
<voice_nw IEV_HSG_HYZ013 0>
Hey, good morning. I wonder what kind of day
today will be.

355698.<voice_nw IEV_HSG_ANR014 0>\n「……私のことを 気遣:
<voice_nw IEV_HSG_ANR014 0>
...Are you worried about me? Hehe, I'm fine.
Thanks. You're really kind.

355699.<voice_nw IEV_HSG_HYZ014 0>\n「ああ おつかれさん。:
<voice_nw IEV_HSG_HYZ014 0>
Nice work today. All done for now? See you
tomorrow!

355704.<voice_nw IEV_HSG_ANR016 0>\n「あ……愛してるって:
Oh... Did you just say "I love you"? If you blurt out something like that, it'll make me blush.
...I care about you just as much as you do. Please stay by my side forever. It's a promise.
